svg.title: Compare identity cues among nearby workshop providers
svg.desc: Only the two Common issuer-mark hrefs change from paired outline squares to offset solid corners. The Gather mark remains paired squares. The complete listing, all text, fonts, sizes, anchors, colors, image bytes/crops, rules and surfaces remain fixed. This is a bounded comparison with one fictional alternative, not evidence of market-wide uniqueness or audience recognition. Fictional original artwork, reused AI-generated photographs and separately composed native typography.
svg.text: Fictional identities · Before/after paired by artifact
